name: Biochemistry [B.S.]
school: College of Literature, Science, and the Arts

requirements.label: 120 Total Credits
requirements.hint: All credits completed at U-M plus posted transfer credit.

requirements.label: 100 LSA Credits
requirements.hint: Credits from courses recognized by LSA (most U-M courses except some SI offerings and other school-specific courses).

requirements.label: 60 BS-Eligible Credits (for BS students only)
requirements.hint: Only counts for students pursuing a Bachelor of Science.

requirements.label: 90 Credits Excluding Experiential and Independent Study Courses
requirements.hint: At least 90 credits must come from standard coursework; internships and independent study don't count.

requirements.label: 60 Credits Outside Biochemistry & Chemistry
requirements.hint: Credits earned in courses outside the Biochemistry & Chemistry department(s).

requirements.label: 90 Credits of Graded Course Work, Including Transfer and Test
requirements.hint: At least 90 credits must carry a letter grade (transfer and test credit included).

requirements.label: 60 Credits of In-Residence Course Work (AA Campus and U-M Study Abroad)
requirements.hint: Credits taken on the Ann Arbor campus or through an approved U-M study abroad program.

requirements.label: 30 Credits Taken While Enrolled in LSA
requirements.hint: Credits earned while officially enrolled in LSA (as opposed to another U-M college).

requirements.label: First Year Writing Requirement
requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.label: Upper Level Writing Requirement
requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.label: Race and Ethnicity Requirement
requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.label: Quantitative Reasoning Requirement
requirements.hint: 1 QR1 or 2 QR2 courses required

requirements.label: Language Requirement
requirements.hint: one 4th term course required, C- minimum, or one course where proficiency is presumed

requirements.label: Area Distribution: 7 Credits in Humanities
requirements.hint: From approved HU-designated courses.

requirements.label: Area Distribution: 7 Credits in Natural Sciences
requirements.hint: From approved NS-designated courses.

requirements.label: Area Distribution: 7 Credits in Social Sciences
requirements.hint: From approved SS-designated courses.

requirements.label: Additional Distribution: complete 3 areas
requirements.hint: Pick any 3 of the area buckets below and hit 3 cr in each. ID credit can count toward 1, 2, or all 3 areas, so the extra ID buckets can stand in for additional areas.

requirements.label: Additional 3 Credits in Humanities
requirements.hint: Beyond the initial 7 cr Humanities.

requirements.label: Additional 3 Credits in Natural Sciences
requirements.hint: Beyond the initial 7 cr Natural Sciences.

requirements.label: Additional 3 Credits in Social Sciences
requirements.hint: Beyond the initial 7 cr Social Sciences.

requirements.label: 3 Credits in Mathematical & Symbolic Analysis
requirements.hint: From approved MSA-designated courses.

requirements.label: 3 Credits in Creative Expression
requirements.hint: From approved CE-designated courses.

requirements.label: 3 Credits in Interdisciplinary
requirements.hint: From approved ID-designated courses.

requirements.label: 3 Additional Credits in Interdisciplinary (Second Area)
requirements.hint: A second 3 cr of ID credit may stand in for a second area.

requirements.label: 3 Additional Credits in Interdisciplinary (Third Area)
requirements.hint: A third 3 cr of ID credit may stand in for a third area.

requirements.label: Introductory Biology
requirements.hint: Complete either the two-course intro sequence or BIOLOGY 195.

requirements.label: Intro Biology two-course sequence
requirements.hint: One of BIOLOGY 171 or 191, plus one of BIOLOGY 172, 174, or 192.

requirements.label: BIOLOGY 195: Introductory Biology
requirements.hint: Single-course alternative to the two-course sequence.

requirements.label: CHEM 210 & 211
requirements.hint: CHEM 210 (Structure and Reactivity I) and CHEM 211 (Investigations in Chemistry).

requirements.label: Calculus I
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: MATH 115, MATH 120

requirements.label: Calculus II
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: MATH 116, MATH 121

requirements.label: Multivariable Calculus or Math Methods
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: MATH 215 (Multivariable and Vector Calculus), CHEM 262 (Mathematical Methods for Physical Scientists)

requirements.label: Physics I
requirements.hint: 1 combination of lecture and lab, or PHYSICS 139.

requirements.label: Physics I lecture and lab
requirements.hint: One lecture (PHYSICS 140, 150, or 160) plus its matching lab (PHYSICS 141, 151, or 161).

requirements.label: PHYSICS 139
requirements.hint: Combined lecture and lab alternative for Physics I.

requirements.label: Physics II
requirements.hint: 1 combination of lecture and lab, or PHYSICS 239.

requirements.label: Physics II lecture and lab
requirements.hint: One lecture (PHYSICS 240, 250, or 260) plus its matching lab (PHYSICS 241, 251, or 261).

requirements.label: PHYSICS 239
requirements.hint: Combined lecture and lab alternative for Physics II.

requirements.label: Analytical or Inorganic Chemistry
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: CHEM 241, CHEM 245, CHEM 302, CHEM 303

requirements.label: Analytical or Organic Lab
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: CHEM 216, CHEM 242, or the CHEM 246 & 247 pair (the pair together fills this one-course option).

requirements.label: CHEM 351: Fundamentals of Biochemistry
requirements.hint: Or approved substitutes.

requirements.label: CHEM 352 or 353
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: CHEM 352, CHEM 353 (Introduction to Biochemical Research Techniques, with or without Scientific Writing)

requirements.label: CHEM 451 & 452
requirements.hint: Advanced Biochemistry: Macromolecular Structure and Function, plus Cellular Processes.

requirements.label: CHEM 453: Biophysical Chemistry I
requirements.hint: Thermodynamics and Kinetics.

requirements.label: Electives: 6 credits from approved list
requirements.hint: 6 credits from the department's approved electives list (upper-level CHEM and BIOLCHEM beyond the core; approved cognates from other departments may also count, check the department list).

requirements.label: Advanced Lab or Undergraduate Research
requirements.hint: Complete 1 of the 2 requirement lines below.

requirements.label: Advanced Lab: 1 course
requirements.hint: 1 course from the approved advanced lab list, such as CHEM 436, 447, 462, 482, or 483; confirm the current list with the department.

requirements.label: Approved Undergraduate Research: 4 credits over 2 semesters
requirements.hint: 4 credits of approved research taken over 2 semesters (2 enrollments), e.g. CHEM 398, 399, 498, 499 or BIOLCHEM 298, 398, 499.

requirements.label: Major Total Credits: minimum 37
requirements.hint: Includes all courses used toward the major requirements, including those from other departments. Does not include any prerequisites.
